description: Show a prepared card’s finished surfaces before payment when preview_available is true. Optional, never required to buy. Returns images and their order revision, plus preview_url for clients that need a browser. Preview again after changes. This does not change, charge or mail the order.

card_id.description: ID from this order.cards[].id. Required when the order has more than one card; omit to preview its only card.

expected_revision.description: Parent order.revision returned by prepare_order, revise_order or read_order. If supplied, a mismatch fails with CONFLICT; omission previews the current revision. Preview again after changes.

faces.description: Surfaces to render; omission means both. Outside/inside are front/back for postcards and flat cards, or cover/inside for folded cards.

order_access_token.description: Exact private order_access_token returned by prepare_order or revise_order for this order. Keep it private and never invent one.

order_id.description: Parent order.id returned by prepare_order, revise_order or read_order. Use the matching private token.

name: preview_card

images.description: Image bytes are in the result content blocks, in this order, not here.

preview_url.description: Browser page showing the same images for every card in this order. No payment control.

title: Preview a card
